project_metadata.job_description: Looking for a highly adaptable, multi-skilled international virtual assistant to act as a core operations coordinator for our US-based business. You will manage a wide variety of daily and weekly tasks ranging from administrative support to active business communications.Core responsibilities include managing media call leads, checking business accounts, replying to messages across platforms, and ensuring that daily/weekly task lists are fully executed. You will be responsible for making sure everything is clearly communicated, tracked, and handled efficiently. Specific day-to-day tasks and additional ad-hoc projects will be discussed in detail during the interview process

Hello! Probation Period & Compensation

All new Virtual Assistants will start with a paid, one-week probation period so that both you and the company can assess whether the position is a good mutual fit.

Week 1 – Probation
Weekly pay: $60
Work schedule: Up to 6 hours per day, 6 days per week

Throughout the probation week, we will assess your performance according to the following criteria:

Attention to detail and accuracy
Responsiveness and communication
Ability to follow directions
Consistency and reliability
Work ethic and professionalism
Upon Successful Completion of Probation

After you successfully finish the probation period, your weekly compensation will rise to:

$90 per week
Up to 6 hours per day, 6 days per week
Performance Evaluations & Pay Raises

Once you have worked with us for 2 weeks to 1 month, we will complete a performance evaluation.

You may be eligible for a weekly increase of $30 or more if you consistently demonstrate accurate and precise work, effective communication, reliability, and a positive work ethic. This would raise your weekly compensation from $90 to at least $120 per week.

Additional raises may also be offered as you continue developing with the company. Compensation increases depend on factors including:

Accurately completing assignments with few errors
Following directions exactly
Consistently meeting deadlines
Maintaining excellent communication
Showing initiative and resolving issues independently
Demonstrating professionalism and dependability
Sharing ideas that contribute to improving the business

We aim to develop a long-term team that rewards dedicated Virtual Assistants for consistently delivering high-quality work. Your compensation can continue increasing as your contributions and responsibilities expand.
